rows.definition: Deep-copy helper (cmd/fak/loop_helpers.go) that snapshots a loop run's int64 metrics map so fired-loop counters can be carried forward or diffed without aliasing the live ledger.
rows.distinction: A value-copy utility over loop metrics maps; it neither schedules fires (loopmgr) nor drives turns (loopdrive).

rows.definition: Fleetpane collector (internal/fleetpane/fleetpane.go) that runs one named loop spec once and returns its LoopCheck, the per-loop probe the `fak info` fleet pane folds over every configured loop.
rows.distinction: One-shot per-loop collection for the fleet info pane; not the durable fire ledger (loopmgr) and not the stage-coverage scorecard (loop-index).

rows.definition: Derivation helper (cmd/fak/loop_helpers.go) that mints the default run-id for a fire of a given loop id when a loop fire carries no explicit run id.
rows.distinction: Mints a run-identifier string; it is not the session identity a run records (loopsession) nor the ledger that stores runs (loopmgr).

rows.definition: Prometheus metric family (fak_bgloop_registered/_ticks_total/_errors_total/_panics_total/_restarts_total/_pauses_total/_last_tick_timestamp_seconds/_up) rendered by gateway.writeBgloopMetrics for every in-kernel supervised background loop.
rows.distinction: Observability counters for the in-kernel supervisor's ticks; they measure bgloop runtime, not the durable externally-scheduled fires recorded by loopmgr.

rows.definition: fakclient helper (pkg/fakclient/loopback.go) that computes an alternative URL to retry when a probe of a configured gateway address fails, falling the client back to the local loopback endpoint.
rows.distinction: A client-side URL-retry rule for unreachable gateways; not the loopback network-address concept itself (loopback) and not a routing decision made by the router.

rows.definition: Injectable os.Executable seam (cmd/fak/loop.go) that resolves the fak binary path a loop fire re-invokes itself with, letting tests point loop self-spawns at a fixture binary.
rows.distinction: A binary-path resolution seam for loop self-execution; it does not schedule or record loops (loopmgr) and is not the per-turn driver that consumes it (loopdrive).

rows.definition: Repeatable CLI flag type (cmd/fak/loop_helpers.go) that accumulates key=value evidence/metrics strings for `fak loop` runs, one entry per flag occurrence.
rows.distinction: A command-line accumulation type for loop-fire inputs; not the loop ledger storage (loopmgr) and not a reported metric (fak_bgloop family).

rows.definition: Constant (cmd/fak/loop.go) naming FAK_PERFORMANCE_RSI_OUTPUT, the environment variable through which a loop fire's child process reports its performance-RSI output file path.
rows.distinction: An env-var-name constant wiring the RSI performance readout into a loop fire; not the RSI keep-or-revert loop itself (rsiloop) and not a loop ledger record (loopmgr).

rows.definition: Constructor (internal/gateway/bgloops.go) that builds the serve gateway's in-kernel bgloop.Supervisor and registers its built-in loops (heartbeat, marketing, fleet-health, upstream-context-window).
rows.distinction: Builds and arms the in-kernel loop runtime; it does not start or stop the loops (startLoops/stopLoops) and is not the durable loop ledger (loopmgr).

rows.definition: Model-config field (internal/model/config.go, json num_loops) giving a transformer architecture's number of stacked block layers.
rows.distinction: A static model-architecture depth knob counting stacked layers; not the batcher's admitted-recurrent-work counter (RecurrentLoops) and not any scheduled execution loop.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher request field (internal/engine/continuous_batcher_types.go) declaring how many recurrent loops of work one request admits, used as the effective execution depth when it exceeds ExecutionDepth.
rows.distinction: An admission-depth counter on a batcher request governing accepted recurrent work; not the model's layer count (NumLoops) and not scheduled loop fires (loopmgr).

rows.definition: Shared registrar (cmd/fak/garden.go) behind the durable garden loops that loads the persisted OS task-schedule registry and adds one persistent garden tick/walk/loop entry with interval and jitter.
rows.distinction: Registers durable OS-scheduled garden jobs; not the in-kernel supervisor registration (newBgloopSupervisor) and not loop-ledger governance (loopmgr).

rows.definition: Server method (internal/gateway/replica_membership.go) forming the fleet-health in-kernel loop body: it arms the replica router after its first probe and then runs RunHealthLoop continuously until the serve context ends.
rows.distinction: The continuous driver hosting RunHealthLoop inside the bgloop supervisor; not the probe-and-interval body itself (RunHealthLoop) and not the supervisor owning its lifecycle (newBgloopSupervisor).

rows.definition: Server method (internal/gateway/bgloops.go) called once from Serve after the listener binds, launching every registered in-kernel background loop on the serve lifecycle context.
rows.distinction: The start half of the in-kernel loop lifecycle; inverse of stopLoops, and it starts the runtime rather than registering loops (newBgloopSupervisor) or recording durable fires (loopmgr).

rows.definition: Server method (internal/gateway/bgloops.go) that cancels the in-kernel background loops and joins their goroutines within a bounded 5-second window so a wedged loop cannot hang gateway shutdown.
rows.distinction: The stop/join half of the in-kernel loop lifecycle; inverse of startLoops, and distinct from loop crash recovery (looprecover) which restarts a failed durable loop.

rows.definition: Struct (cmd/fak/superloop_drive_exec.go) recording how `fak superloop drive --execute` handled one driven member's own front door: requested flag, kind, command, note, and outcome.
rows.distinction: The per-member execute receipt of a superloop drive; not the read-only intent walker (superloop) nor the Ralph loop driver (loopdrive).

rows.definition: Emitter (cmd/fak/loop_performance_rsi.go) that renders one `fak loop run --json` report to stdout/stderr from the run's ledger, loop id, run id, and outcome map.
rows.distinction: The JSON report renderer for a single loop run; it emits a report, it does not store the run (loopmgr) or mint its identifiers (defaultLoopRunID).
